Get ready to sing your heart out and test your Bollywood music knowledge with friends in a fun, chill night!

About this Event

🎤 Bollywood Karaoke & Music Trivia Night 🎶
Love singing Bollywood songs? Here’s your chance to grab the mic and be the star of the night! 🌟
Join us for an evening of Bollywood Karaoke, Music Trivia, laughter, and loads of masti!
From evergreen classics and 90s nostalgia to today’s biggest Bollywood hits, come sing your heart out!
🎶 What’s in Store?
🎤 Bollywood Karaoke – Pick your favorite song and take the mic! Sing solo, perform a duet, or team up with friends. No singing skills required — just enthusiasm!
🧠 Fun Music Trivia – Test your Bollywood music knowledge with entertaining guess-the-song challenges and musical surprises.
🎉 Music, Masti & Good Vibes – Sing along, cheer for your friends, and enjoy a fun evening with fellow Bollywood lovers!
🎟️ FREE Entry & Participation – Registration Required! Minimum one food or drink order per attendee is required. Food and beverages are available for purchase at the venue.
🌟 Everyone Is Welcome!
Whether you’re a karaoke superstar or a bathroom singer, this night is for you!
Register now and get ready to sing your heart out!

Also check out other Music events in Bothell.
